abstract: The appearance of a seminoma in a 16-year-old patient with testicular feminization syndrome is reported. There is a high incidence of malignant degeneration of the gonads associated with this syndrome. The consensus is that exploration and gonadectomy are indicated immediately after puberty.
abstract_ja: 16歳の精巣女性化症候群患者に生じたセミノーマの症例を報告する。本症候群では性腺の悪性変化の頻度が高い。思春期直後の探索開腹と性腺摘出術が直ちに適応となるというのが一致した見解である。
